model.description: {@link MlModel} associated with this monitoring result.

groupByValue.description: The grouped column/attribute values, if {@link MlModel.Monitor.Group#groupBy} is present.

predictions.description: Predictions used for producing this result.

labels.description: Labels used for producing this result.

contexts.description: Contexts used for producing this result

title:
{@link MlModel.Monitor.Batch} represents a batch of metric calculations for a {@link #model} for
a given aggregation slice {@link #groupByValue} of data. For the given {@link #predictions}, {@link #labels},
and {@link #contexts} data, all metrics in {@link MlModel.Monitor.Group#metrics} are calculated.
This is primarily used to describe the calculations that a {@link MlModel.Monitor.BatchResult} is responsible for.
See {@link MlModel.Monitor.BatchResult#batches}.
name: MlModel.Monitor.Batch
